checkpoint_selection: minimum fixed train-only correspondence objective; earliest tie; dropout disabled; RNG reset for every check
fit_population: all 784 patches of all 1869 train images; L2-normalized 70-D codes
source_policy: pinned reference active defaults, not calibrated C/D/E shifts
evaluation: only after all three seeds predictions and names sealed
collapse_policy: Report >=3 fixed train monitor checks with cross-image pair cosine >.99 or pixel std <.01; preserve fixed5000 budget; no retuning
